entries.example: Mary Pimm is a very tall woman.

entries.def: If you aren't tall or short, you are medium height.
To ask if someone is tall or short, we say:
entries.example: How tall is Mary/Tom? She's 1.60 metres tall. / He's 1.48 metres tall.
Dolly Ryan is really slim.
I was very thin when I was in hospital.
A rather fat man opened the door.

entries.def: (= more kilos than is good for me)
entries.example: The doctor said I am overweight.
